mp.pillar: Sustained Dominance: higher positions, longer presence and higher peak positions on Most Popular.
observations: The top holds: Steal An Egg (98 days), Brookhaven, DONT SPLASH (14 days), RIVALS, Murder Mystery 2 and 99 Nights in the Forest again lead the pillar.

Anomaly horror and young simulators led the climbers: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: the ANOMALY +43 at 432 days, Throw Food For Animals +20 at 43 days, It Hears The Water [DONT SPLASH] +16 at 17 days, Superhero Arena +14 and Deagle Arena +12.
Halloween titles slipped on the last day of the event: A Long Flight [HALLOWEEN] -23, Ride a Dino -22, The Mimic -13 (its second straight fall) and Fisch -14.

Fourteen games entered, among them Raise The Biggest Family (18 days), +1 Anime Eyes (17 days), Realistic Car Destruction (16 days), Say Cheese! (12 days) and the 2,490-day Survive the Killer!; thirteen left, including Blade Ball, Grow a Garden and two '+1' games.
Games aged 123 to 365 days sit at the 35th median percentile against the 53rd for 15-42-day games and the 56th for multi-year evergreens, the mid-life trough again (H-mp-009 at 48%).
patterns: Recent updates consistently go with higher positions now (H-mp-006 up from 58% to 75%), and games left more than 21 days without one stay fewer days (r=-0.55).
Pricing tends to go with staying power: median products above 400 R$ split days on the chart at r=+0.49 and median passes above 77 R$ at r=+0.46 (H-mp-011, H-mp-016 at 65%).
Solo loops no longer clearly sit lower (H-mp-003 fell from 73% to 53%), while more original concepts consistently hold higher positions (H-mp-013 at 78%).

Collect-upgrade-rebirth loops sit at the 16th median percentile and wave-survival co-op at the 30th, against 61st-66th for PvP, steal-defend-base and job sims; a loop test is proposed today, though only three collect-rebirth games are on the chart.
Big evergreens consistently convert fewer visits into favorites (H-mp-010 at 79%), so a high favorite rate here marks a young game, not a durable one.

outliers.name: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: the ANOMALY
outliers.note: A 432-day game jumped 43 places on a same-day horror update, far outside the mid-life trough; the anomaly-job format (H-x-006) and a Halloween update are the likely reasons.

outliers.note: A 17-day spin-off branded with DONT SPLASH's name climbed 16 places, showing the noise-rule horror wave (H-x-019) carrying a second game onto Most Popular.

outliers.name: [🔥AURA] Phonk Edit Tower 🎶
outliers.note: 95% likes yet weakest on the pillar at 331 days and 12 days since an update, consistent with fixed-stage obbies fading (H-mp-025) and the update gap (H-mp-018).

te.pillar: Monetization Efficiency: earning a high position with modest CCU (Monetization Score ranks position × CCU, lower is better).
observations: Donation hubs again top efficiency (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS), followed by Momo City (655 days, no passes), Build and Burn (26 days) and Elemental Dungeons.
The least efficient are this month's breakouts: +1 Anime Eyes (17 days, 46 passes), DONT SPLASH, Bike For Egg! and Throw Food For Animals, all with high CCU and revenue still catching up.

My Small Business climbed 146 at 14 days, Mechanic Legends 113, Evomon 108, Survive the Killer! 101 and DRIVE: Highway 96; Dream Car Collection (-63), Grow a Plant (-60) and Steal the Moon (-50) fell most.

Twenty-one games entered (Cameraman Tower Defense, Lawn Care Empire, World of Nukes with 293 products, Depth Incremental among them) and nineteen left, including Attack on Titan Revolution and Grow a Garden 2.
Efficiency rises with age, from the 1st median percentile at 0-14 days and the 31st at 15-42 days to the 61st past a year (H-te-001 at 83%).
patterns: Pricing high consistently pays: median products above 79 R$ (r=+0.43), a pass above about 729-999 R$ and median passes near 400 R$ all hold at 86% (H-te-005, H-te-006, H-te-025).
RPGs (r=+0.47), roleplay hubs (+0.32) and more complex builds (rho=+0.25) consistently earn more per player, while Survival (-0.37) and Simulation (-0.23) consistently earn less.

Steal-and-defend-base loops are the weakest earners per player (r=-0.57, 18th median percentile; H-te-024 at 86%) and 'Egg' titles split efficiency at r=-0.81, the sharpest keyword effect on any chart.
Tower-defense loops consistently earn more per player (H-te-044 up to 79%); a roll or luck layer tends to help too (H-te-037 at 69%).
Servers above about 40 players split efficiency at r=+0.37, consistent with H-te-007 (25+ players at 86%).

outliers.name: [🏠HOUSES]Momo City [Beta]
outliers.note: Entered among the most efficient earners with no game passes and 31 products, against the pass-pricing rules; a single-player life sim selling houses and furniture to a loyal audience is the likely reason.

outliers.name: 🧸 My Small Business
outliers.note: Climbed 146 places at 14 days, the clearest case today of revenue catching up with a breakout's players (H-te-018).

outliers.name: [🌍UPD] +1 Anime Eyes
outliers.note: The least efficient earner despite 46 passes and 105 products: a huge, cheap catalogue does not offset a '+1' template's weak revenue per player (H-te-004 at 84%).

patterns: Like ratio now tends to go with momentum within the same age band (H-tt-004 up from 47% to 61%), and several page images tend to as well (H-tt-020 up from 42% to 65%).
Smaller servers tend to help young games (H-tt-049 at 69%, servers above 23 at r=-0.32), and solo games held higher positions within age (+0.34), against H-tt-008 (32%) and the Top Earning split.
Simulation-genre games hold higher positions within the same age band (+0.40) while Simulation earns less per player on Top Earning; a tested hypothesis is proposed today.
Emoji in titles go with stronger momentum (rho=+0.34, within-age +0.24) and badges with lower positions (-0.35 within age); both are proposed as tests.
Sandbox-physics (79th), simulation-job (76th) and wave-survival co-op (67th) loops lead, while story adventures (17th) and roleplay (25th) trail, the same order as yesterday.

uc.pillar: Breakout Popularity: higher positions within Up-and-Coming.
observations: +1 Spider Arm (12 days) now leads, ahead of DONT SPLASH, Say Cheese! (12 days), +1 Anime Eyes, Raise The Biggest Family and Ragdoll Playground.

Make Viral Candy! (+31, 13 days), Fart With Your Friends! (+20), Realistic Ragdoll Playground (+19) and Depth Incremental (+19) rose most; Thai Quiz Duels (-23), Grapple Strike (-21) and VERITY'S PIZZERIA RUN (-19) fell most.

Eleven games entered, including Create A Disaster (14 days), Tesla Roadster Chase (10 days), PORTALS, Clean the Moon! and steal a strange egg; ten left, among them Beat Up Verity, Steal an Anime Pack and Break a Brainrot Lucky Block.
The newest games lead: 0-14 days at the 64th median percentile against the 47th at 15-42 days and the 29th at 43-84 days (H-uc-005 at 64%).
patterns: Collect-upgrade-rebirth loops rank lowest (r=-0.52, 23rd median percentile) while sandbox-physics loops rank highest (83rd; H-uc-036 at 65%); a loop test for collect-rebirth is proposed today.

A collection index now goes with lower positions (within-age -0.35), so H-uc-033 is down to 27%, the opposite of its Top Trending counterpart (H-tt-028 at 69%).
Several breakout ideas weakened sharply today: pet/egg loops (H-uc-001, 63% to 39%), co-op loops (H-uc-019, 66% to 47%) and everyday-life roleplay (H-uc-031, 66% to 48%).
Build and craft loops now tend to rank lower (H-uc-029 up from 40% to 66%), and cash-tycoon loops consistently do (H-uc-016 at 73%).

summary: Simulation splits reach from revenue: young simulators hold higher Top Trending positions within age (+0.40) yet consistently earn less per player (H-te-027 at 86%), the same pattern as the steal/egg template (H-x-002) and survival framing.
Collect-upgrade-rebirth loops trail on three charts at once (16th percentile on Most Popular, 23rd on Up-and-Coming, 35th on Top Earning); two loop tests are proposed today.
Ragdoll physics keeps spreading: two ragdoll sandboxes lead Top Trending momentum and 'Ragdoll' titles lift Up-and-Coming; H-x-021 rises to 65%.

Anomaly and noise-rule horror carried old and new games alike onto Most Popular (Scary Shawarma Kiosk +43, It Hears The Water +16), while plain Halloween horror (The Mimic, A Long Flight) slipped on the event's last day.
Halloween ends today; a qualitative test is proposed on whether [🎃]-tagged games lose ground in the first week of November unless they ship a follow-up.

No gameplay videos were labelled today: the four queued long-running hits (Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG, Basketball: Zero) are marked frames_ready but again arrived with zero frames.
